items.title: 〈財報〉 Sandisk財測不如預期 蓋過亮眼財報 盤後挫逾6%
items.title_en: <Earnings> Sandisk Forecast Misses Expectations, Overshadows Strong Results; Shares Drop Over 6% After Hours
paras: Sandisk(SNDK-US)周三 (5 日) 盤後公布優於預期的 2026 會計年度第 4 季財報，但因本季營收展望低於市場預估，盤後股價仍下跌，顯示投資人對這家記憶體大廠寄予更高期待。

F2027Q1 財測關鍵數字 vs 分析師預測


營收：103-108 億美元 vs 108.2 億美元
 non-GAAP EPS：44-46 美元 vs 44.72 美元


Sandisk 今年以來股價已累計飆升 469%，過去一年更大漲 3108%，在股價大幅上漲後，市場對財報及財測的要求也更加嚴格，因此即使最新一季業績優於預期，仍不足以滿足投資人的高期待。
截稿前，Sandisk 周三盤後股價下挫 6.6%。該股周三稍早收盤已跌 5.4%，以每股 1350.50 美元作收。
財報關鍵數字 vs 分析師預測

Q4


 調整後 EPS：39.25 美元 vs 34.96 美元
淨利：69 億美元
營收：89.7 億美元 vs 84.8 億美元 


F2026 全年

調整後 EPS：73.76 美元
淨利：114.3 億美元
營收：202.5 億美元 (年增 175%)


Sandisk 第 4 季營收較去年同期暴增 3.7 倍，從 19 億美元攀升到 89.7 億美元，優於分析師預測的 84.8 億美元。調整後每股獲利 39.25 美元，也優於分析師所估的 34.96 美元，及去年同期的僅 0.29 美元。
在人工智慧 (AI) 熱潮帶動下，記憶體等關鍵零組件需求遠高於供給。包括亞馬遜 (AMZN-US)、Meta(META-US) 及 Alphabet(GOOGL-US)等大型雲端服務商正投入數千億美元建設資料中心，推升相關硬體需求。
供不應求的市況也帶動硬體廠商調高價格，成為 Sandisk 近年業績大幅成長的重要推力。
Sandisk 第 4 季資料中心業務營收 29.8 億美元，高於市場預估的 27.4 億美元，與第 3 季相比增加超過一倍。
執行長 David Goeckeler 表示，Sandisk 以領先的技術產品組合完成 2026 會計年度，並將資料中心打造為核心成長動能，同時進一步深化與客戶的合作關係。
Sandisk 表示，自 4 月以來，在新的商業模式下已另外簽署五項協議，其中包括三家新客戶，以及兩項既有客戶的合作擴大案。
Sandisk 董事會也批准新增 140 億美元庫藏股計畫，使該公司剩餘可執行的股票回購額度提高至 155 億美元。
paras_en: Sandisk (SNDK-US) announced after the close on Wednesday (the 5th) that its fiscal 2026 fourth‑quarter results beat expectations, but because its revenue outlook for the quarter fell short of market forecasts, the stock fell after hours, showing investors have higher expectations for the memory‑chip giant.
Key forecast numbers for FY2027 Q1 versus analyst estimates: Revenue: $10.3‑$10.8 billion vs $10.82 billion; non‑GAAP EPS: $44‑$46 vs $44.72.

Since the start of the year Sandisk’s share price has surged 469%, and over the past twelve months it has jumped 3,108%. After such a steep rally, the market’s standards for earnings and guidance have tightened, so even though the latest quarter beat expectations, it was not enough to satisfy investors’ lofty hopes.
By the deadline, Sandisk’s after‑hours share price on Wednesday was down 6.6%. Earlier that day the stock had already fallen 5.4% to close at $1,350.50 per share.
Key earnings numbers versus analyst estimates for Q4: Adjusted EPS: $39.25 vs $34.96; Net income: $6.9 billion; Revenue: $8.97 billion vs $8.48 billion.
Full‑year FY2026: Adjusted EPS: $73.76; Net income: $11.43 billion; Revenue: $20.25 billion (up 175% year‑over‑year).

Sandisk’s Q4 revenue jumped 3.7‑fold year‑over‑year, rising from $1.9 billion to $8.97 billion, beating analysts’ $8.48 billion estimate. Adjusted EPS of $39.25 also topped the $34.96 consensus and the $0.29 a year ago.

The AI boom has driven demand for memory and other key components far above supply. Large cloud providers such as Amazon (AMZN-US), Meta (META-US) and Alphabet (GOOGL-US) are investing hundreds of billions of dollars in data‑center construction, boosting hardware demand.
The supply‑demand imbalance has also allowed hardware makers to raise prices, which has been a major driver of Sandisk’s recent strong performance.
Sandisk’s data‑center revenue for Q4 was $2.98 billion, above the market’s $2.74 billion estimate and more than double the Q3 figure.
CEO David Goeckeler said Sandisk completed fiscal 2026 with a leading‑technology product portfolio and will make data centers the core growth engine while deepening customer partnerships.
Sandisk said that since April, under its new business model it has signed five additional agreements, including three new customers and two expanded deals with existing customers.
The board also approved an additional $14 billion share‑repurchase program, raising the company’s remaining authorized buyback capacity to $15.5 billion.

items.title: IonQ揭量子運算財報季序幕 營收暴增近4倍、上修全年財測
items.title_en: IonQ Unveils Quantum Computing Earnings Season with Revenue Surge of Nearly 4 Times
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，IonQ(QBTS-US)周三 (5 日) 率先揭開量子運算公司財報季序幕，執行長形容，這是公司「史上最強一季」。
總部位於美國馬里蘭州的 IonQ，近年已從量子運算拓展至量子網路與量子感測等相關技術領域。
公司 2026 會計年度第二季調整後每股虧損為 0.33 美元，優於分析師預估的虧損 0.56 美元。
真正亮點來自營收。第二季營收達 8,010 萬美元，較去年同期暴增近 4 倍，高於華爾街預估的 6,650 萬美元。管理層表示，營收大幅成長主要受惠於商業客戶對 Tempo 量子電腦需求增加，以及雲端運算服務需求持續強勁。
儘管營收大幅成長，IonQ 本季淨虧損仍擴大至約 19 億美元。公司調整後 EBITDA(稅息折舊及攤銷前) 虧損為 1.203 億美元，主要反映與 SkyWater Technologies(SKYT-US) 商業合作，以及收購交易相關成本。去年同期淨虧損與調整後 EBITDA 虧損分別為 1.775 億美元及 3,650 萬美元。
市場對此並不感到意外：IonQ 目前仍未獲利，儘管其技術持續獲得企業與政府客戶青睞。對目前的量子運算產業而言，獲利能力並非投資人最關心的指標，他們正等待本世代末有望成為市場催化劑的關鍵技術里程碑。
財報公布後，IonQ 盤後股價一度上漲約 2%。該股周三收盤下跌 2%。
市場反應偏正面，部分原因在於公司上調全年財測。IonQ 目前預估，2026 年全年營收將介於 2.8 億至 2.9 億美元，高於先前預估的 2.6 億至 2.7 億美元。分析師平均預估全年營收約 2.686 億美元。
為了在量子運算商業化前進一步提升競爭力，IonQ 近年積極透過併購擴大布局。上周完成對晶片製造商 SkyWater Technologies 價值 18 億美元的收購案。藉此將 SkyWater 旗下半導體晶圓代工能力納入，進一步掌握量子硬體供應鏈。
這項交易也正值美國政府進一步強化國內量子供應鏈之際。今年 5 月，包括 Rigetti Computing(RGTI-US) 及 D-Wave Quantum(QBTS-US) 等多家上市公司，已與美國商務部達成初步協議，以釋出部分股權換取聯邦政府資金支持。
雖然 IonQ 並未參與這項協議，但仍是美國政府的重要合作夥伴。執行長 Niccolo de Masi 於去年 7 月出席白宮量子創新峰會，進一步展現公司與美國聯邦政府之間的緊密合作關係。IonQ 去年底已成立專門服務政府客戶的事業部門。
paras_en: IonQ (QBTS-US) kicked off the quantum computing earnings season on Wednesday (5th), with CEO Niccolo de Masi describing it as the company's "strongest quarter ever".
Headquartered in Maryland, USA, IonQ has expanded its focus from quantum computing to quantum networks and quantum sensing in recent years.
For the second quarter of 2026, IonQ reported an adjusted loss per share of $0.33, beating analysts' estimates of a loss of $0.56.
The real highlight came from revenue, which reached $80.1 million, a nearly 4-fold increase from the same period last year, exceeding Wall Street's estimate of $66.5 million.
Management attributed the significant revenue growth to increased demand from commercial customers for the Tempo quantum computer and strong demand for cloud computing services.

Despite the significant revenue growth, IonQ's net loss for the quarter expanded to approximately $1.9 billion. The company's adjusted EBITDA (earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization) loss was $1.203 billion, mainly reflecting commercial cooperation with SkyWater Technologies (SKYT-US) and costs related to the acquisition.

The market was not surprised by this, as IonQ is still not profitable, despite its technology being favored by corporate and government customers. In the current quantum computing industry, profitability is not the most important metric for investors, who are waiting for key milestones that could become catalysts for the market by the end of this decade.
After the earnings release, IonQ's stock price rose by about 2% after hours. The stock closed down 2% on Wednesday.

The market reaction was generally positive, partly due to the company's upward revision of its full-year revenue guidance. IonQ now expects 2026 full-year revenue to be between $2.8 billion and $2.9 billion, higher than its previous estimate of $2.6 billion to $2.7 billion.

To further enhance its competitiveness in commercializing quantum computing, IonQ has actively expanded its layout through acquisitions in recent years. Last week, it completed the acquisition of SkyWater Technologies for $18 billion, which will bring SkyWater's semiconductor wafer foundry capabilities under its control and further grasp the quantum hardware supply chain.

This transaction coincides with the US government's further strengthening of its domestic supply chain. In May this year, several listed companies, including Rigetti Computing (RGTI-US) and D-Wave Quantum (QBTS-US), have reached preliminary agreements with the US Department of Commerce to release part of their equity in exchange for federal government funding support.

Although IonQ did not participate in this agreement, it is still an important partner of the US federal government. CEO Niccolo de Masi attended the White House Quantum Innovation Summit in July last year, further demonstrating the company's close cooperation with the US federal government. IonQ established a dedicated business unit to serve government customers at the end of last year.

items.title: 美禁中國光模組恐傷AI競爭力！研究：西方產能兩年內難補缺口
items.title_en: U.S. Ban on Chinese Optical Modules Could Hurt AI Competitiveness, Study Says Western Capacity Won't Fill Gap Within Two Years
paras: 美國擬限制中國光收發模組 (Optical Transceiver) 進口，引發市場看好美國供應商可望受惠，但最新研究指出，若禁令倉促上路，反而可能衝擊美國 AI 基礎建設發展。
根據外媒週三 (5 日) 報導，Counterpoint Research 警告，中國廠商目前掌握全球約六成至三分之二的光收發模組供應能力，西方廠商至少未來一至兩年內仍無法完全填補產能缺口。
Counterpoint 分析師 Neil Shah 表示，美國若迅速實施禁令，可能導致光模組供應不足，進一步推高建置成本、延後 AI 資料中心部署時程，甚至降低昂貴 AI 加速器 (Accelerator) 的使用效率，影響大型科技公司數千億美元的資本支出規畫。
Shah 指出，AWS、微軟 (MSFT-US)、Meta (META-US) 及 Alphabet (GOOG-US) 等超大規模雲端業者，未來都可能面臨 AI 叢集 (AI Cluster) 建設延誤的風險。他表示，若監管政策突然改變，恐造成硬體供應瓶頸，拖慢全球大型雲端服務商的 AI 部署進度。
此前，《路透》週二報導，美國總統川普政府正研擬禁止進口新的中國資料中心光收發模組，並希望聯邦通訊委員會 (FCC) 能在今年底前公布相關規範。不過，該措施目前仍在討論階段，內容仍可能修改，甚至取消。
光收發模組是 AI 資料中心的重要元件，負責將電子訊號轉換為光訊號，在光纖中高速傳輸資料。隨著 AI 超級叢集對 400G、800G 及 1.6T 高速互連需求快速提升，其重要性也持續增加。
Raymond James 指出，若禁令正式實施，美股上市公司 Coherent (COHR-US) 及 Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI-US) 將是最直接受惠者，有望承接原本流向中國供應商的訂單。
不過，Counterpoint 認為，美國供應商短時間內仍難以完全接手。Shah 表示，Coherent 及 Lumentum 目前仍缺乏足夠的無塵室產能、自動化封裝能力及量產良率，至少未來 12 至 24 個月內，難以承接中際旭創 (Innolight) 及新易盛 (Eoptolink) 的龐大出貨規模。
受路透報導影響，中國光通訊族群周三全面走弱。海外營收占比高達 96% 的新易盛深圳股價一度重挫 10%；中際旭創 A 股及港股同步下跌約 8%；天孚通信 (Suzhou TFC Optical Communications) 跌約 6%，滬深 300 電信服務指數盤中一度下跌 9%。
相較之下，美國光通訊族群前一交易日大漲。Coherent 收漲 11%、Applied Optoelectronics 勁揚 18%、Lumentum 上漲 7%，市場預期若禁令落實，西方供應商將有機會獲得更多訂單。
Counterpoint 統計，中際旭創目前約占全球資料中心光收發模組營收 27%，2026 年第一季有 62% 營收來自美國市場；整體中國廠商則掌握約 60% 的全球資料中心光收發模組營收。
雖然中際旭創與新易盛近年均已將部分產能移往泰國，以降低美中貿易政策帶來的風險，但目前仍不清楚泰國生產的產品是否能豁免於未來禁令之外。
Shah 強調，將全球光收發模組市場簡單切割為「中國」與「非中國」兩個體系，並不符合產業實際運作模式。他指出，目前全球 AI 產業仍高度依賴中國光模組廠商的大規模製造能力。
此外，整體供應鏈本身也高度全球化。中國光模組廠商仍須採用博通 (AVGO-US)、Marvell (MRVL-US) 的數位訊號處理器 (DSP)，以及 Lumentum、Coherent 與三菱電機 (Mitsubishi Electric) 的雷射元件，因此任何禁令都可能擾亂整條高度整合的全球供應鏈，而非單純將市場一分為二。
值得注意的是，中際旭創甫於 7 月 30 日在香港完成約 68 億美元上市，為今年香港最大規模 IPO；該公司也於今年 6 月被美國國防部列入涉嫌與中國軍方有關聯企業名單。
目前 Applied Optoelectronics 是少數具備美國本土生產能力的主要供應商，並持續擴充產能。Raymond James 也認為，若 Coherent 未來決定投入相關投資，也具備在美國建立光收發模組產線的潛力。
paras_en: The United States is planning to restrict imports of Chinese optical transceiver modules, prompting market optimism that U.S. suppliers could benefit. However, a new study warns that a rushed ban could actually damage the development of U.S. AI infrastructure.

According to foreign media reports on Wednesday (the 5th), Counterpoint Research cautioned that Chinese manufacturers currently control roughly 60% to two‑thirds of global optical transceiver supply, and Western firms will be unable to fully close the capacity gap for at least one to two years.

Counterpoint analyst Neil Shah said that if the U.S. implements the ban quickly, it could create a shortage of optical modules, driving up build‑out costs, delaying AI data‑center deployments, and even reducing the efficiency of expensive AI accelerators—affecting the multi‑hundred‑billion‑dollar capital‑expenditure plans of large tech companies.

Shah noted that mega‑scale cloud providers such as AWS, Microsoft (MSFT-US), Meta (META-US) and Alphabet (GOOG-US) could all face delays in constructing AI clusters. He warned that a sudden regulatory shift could create hardware supply bottlenecks and slow the AI rollout of the world’s biggest cloud operators.

Earlier, Reuters reported on Tuesday that the Trump administration was drafting a ban on new Chinese data‑center optical transceivers and hoped the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) would issue related rules by the end of the year. The measure is still under discussion and could be revised or dropped.

Optical transceiver modules are critical components of AI data centers, converting electrical signals to optical signals for high‑speed fiber transmission. As AI super‑clusters increase demand for 400G, 800G and 1.6T interconnects, their importance continues to grow.

Raymond James said that if the ban is enacted, U.S. listed companies Coherent (COHR-US) and Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI-US) would be the most direct beneficiaries, likely capturing orders that would otherwise go to Chinese suppliers.

Counterpoint, however, believes U.S. suppliers cannot take over the market in the short term. Shah explained that Coherent and Lumentum still lack sufficient clean‑room capacity, automated packaging capability and mass‑production yields, making it unlikely they can absorb the large shipment volumes of Innolight and Eoptolink for the next 12‑24 months.

Following Reuters’ report, Chinese optical‑communication stocks fell across the board on Wednesday. Shenzhen‑listed Eoptolink, which derives 96% of its revenue from overseas, saw its share price plunge about 10%; Innolight’s A‑shares and Hong Kong shares dropped roughly 8%; and TFC Optical Communications fell about 6%, while the CSI 300 Telecom Services Index slid as much as 9% intraday.

In contrast, U.S. optical‑communication stocks surged the previous trading day. Coherent rose 11%, Applied Optoelectronics jumped 18%, and Lumentum gained 7%, as the market anticipates that a ban would channel more orders to Western suppliers.

Counterpoint estimates that Innolight currently accounts for about 27% of global data‑center optical transceiver revenue and that 62% of its Q1‑2026 revenue will come from the U.S.; overall, Chinese firms hold roughly 60% of global data‑center optical transceiver revenue.

Although Innolight and Eoptolink have shifted part of their production to Thailand in recent years to mitigate U.S.–China trade risks, it remains unclear whether Thai‑made products would be exempt from a future ban.

Shah emphasized that simply dividing the global optical transceiver market into “China” and “non‑China” segments does not reflect industry reality. He pointed out that the worldwide AI sector still heavily relies on the large‑scale manufacturing capacity of Chinese optical‑module makers.

Moreover, the supply chain is highly globalized. Chinese optical‑module firms still use Broadcom (AVGO-US) and Marvell (MRVL-US) digital signal processors, as well as lasers from Lumentum, Coherent and Mitsubishi Electric, meaning any ban could disrupt an integrated global supply chain rather than just split the market.

It is worth noting that Innolight completed a roughly $6.8 billion IPO in Hong Kong on July 30, the largest Hong Kong listing this year, and was added to a U.S. Department of Defense list in June of companies suspected of ties to the Chinese military.

Applied Optoelectronics is currently one of the few major suppliers with U.S. domestic production capability and is expanding capacity. Raymond James also believes that if Coherent decides to invest in the area, it has the potential to build an optical transceiver production line in the United States.

items.title: 〈能源盤後〉油價震盪收盤 市場觀望美伊談判與荷姆茲海峽動向
items.title_en: Energy Market Closes with Fluctuations as Investors Watch US-Iran Negotiations and Hormuz Strait Developments
paras: 國際油價周三 (5 日) 漲跌互見，布蘭特原油小幅收高，美國西德州中質原油 (WTI) 則收低，投資人持續權衡美國與伊朗緊張局勢可望降溫的預期，以及荷姆茲海峽重新恢復航運、帶動中東原油供應回流的可能性。

布蘭特原油期貨收上漲 9 美分或 0.11%，報每桶 79.45 美元。
WTI 原油期貨收跌 55 美分或 0.73%，報每桶 75.22 美元。


美國總統川普周二表示，美國與伊朗進行了「一整天的談判」，並形容協商進展正面，但同時警告，若無法達成協議，美方將「強力打擊」伊朗。
伊朗則否認雙方已展開和平談判。不過，伊朗外交部周三表示，伊朗與阿曼已就荷姆茲海峽管理方式達成共識，雙方正準備發布聯合聲明。
在今年 2 月底戰爭爆發前，全球約 20% 的原油與液化天然氣 (LNG) 運輸須經過荷姆茲海峽。
Price Futures Group 資深分析師 Phil Flynn 表示，市場仍抱持樂觀，但態度審慎，「這項協議看起來和過去的協議一樣脆弱，而我們都知道，先前那些協議沒有一個維持太久。」
市場對停戰談判取得進展的預期，已帶動布蘭特原油周二重挫 5%，收盤價自 7 月 13 日以來首度跌破每桶 80 美元。
IG 分析師指出，目前談判最大的癥結仍在於，伊朗是否仍堅持對荷姆茲海峽擁有部分控制權，以及美國是否會拒絕接受這項安排。
美國煉油廠降低煉油量，加上原油進口小幅增加，也對油價形成部分壓力。
美國能源資訊署 (EIA) 公布，截至上周，美國商業原油庫存增加 250 萬桶至 4.07 億桶，高於市場原先預估的減少 150 萬桶。
Lipow Oil Associates 總裁 Andrew Lipow 表示，WTI 表現較弱，主要因為俄克拉荷馬州庫欣 (Cushing) 交割中心庫存增加幅度高於市場預期。
不過，紅海航運風險仍限制油價跌幅。葉門親伊朗武裝組織「青年運動」(Houthis，亦稱胡塞武裝)周三表示，已在沙烏地阿拉伯延布 (Yanbu) 外海攻擊一艘沙國油輪。延布是沙國重要原油出口港。
除了波斯灣之外，俄烏雙方近期加大對黑海船舶、港口及出口終端設施的攻擊，也持續干擾全球大宗商品供應。
市場消息人士指出，哈薩克原油主要出口管道──裏海管線聯盟 (Caspian Pipeline Consortium，CPC) 本周也因安全疑慮及油輪不足，多次暫停營運。
另一方面，中國 8 月進一步放寬燃料出口管制，也為市場供應帶來新的變數。
paras_en: International oil prices saw mixed trends on Wednesday, with Brent crude edging up and US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude falling, as investors continued to weigh the prospects of easing US-Iran tensions and the potential resumption of oil supplies from the Middle East through the Hormuz Strait.
Brent crude futures rose by 9 cents, or 0.11%, to $79.45 per barrel, while WTI crude futures fell by 55 cents, or 0.73%, to $75.22 per barrel.

US President Trump stated on Tuesday that the US had engaged in a full day of negotiations with Iran, describing the talks as positive, but warned that if an agreement was not reached, the US would take strong action against Iran. However, Iran denied that peace talks had begun.

The Iranian Foreign Ministry announced on Wednesday that Iran and Oman had reached a consensus on the management of the Hormuz Strait and were preparing to issue a joint statement. Prior to the outbreak of war in late February, around 20% of global oil and liquefied natural gas (LNG) shipments passed through the Hormuz Strait.

Phil Flynn, a senior analyst at Price Futures Group, noted that the market remains optimistic but cautious, stating that the agreement appears as fragile as past ones, and 'we all know that none of those agreements lasted very long.'
Expectations of progress in the ceasefire talks had driven Brent crude down 5% on Tuesday, with the closing price falling below $80 per barrel for the first time since July 13.

IG analysts pointed out that the biggest obstacle in the current negotiations is whether Iran will insist on maintaining some control over the Hormuz Strait and whether the US will accept such an arrangement.

The reduction in US refinery output and a slight increase in crude oil imports have also put downward pressure on oil prices. The US Energy Information Administration (EIA) reported that US commercial crude oil inventories rose by 2.5 million barrels to 407 million barrels as of last week, exceeding market expectations of a 1.5 million barrel decrease.
Andrew Lipow, president of Lipow Oil Associates, stated that WTI's weaker performance was mainly due to the higher-than-expected increase in inventory levels at the Cushing delivery hub in Oklahoma.

However, the risk of shipping in the Red Sea continues to limit the decline in oil prices. The Iran-backed Yemeni militant group 'Houthis' announced on Wednesday that it had attacked a Saudi oil tanker off the coast of Yanbu, a major oil export port in Saudi Arabia.

In addition to the Persian Gulf, the recent escalation of attacks by Russian and Ukrainian forces on ships, ports, and export terminals in the Black Sea has continued to disrupt global commodity supplies. Market sources noted that the Caspian Pipeline Consortium (CPC), Kazakhstan's main oil export pipeline, has been suspended several times this week due to security concerns and a shortage of oil tankers.
On the other hand, China's further relaxation of fuel export controls in August has introduced new variables into the market supply.

items.title: 馬斯克點名SpaceX全面導入輝達AI晶片 AMD慘崩超7%、輝達喜揚超3%
items.title_en: Musk Names AMD's Collapse and NVIDIA's Surge in AI Chip Market
paras: SpaceX 上市後首場財報法說會意外成為 AI 晶片市場焦點。執行長馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 宣布，未來 SpaceX 的 AI 基礎設施將全面採用輝達 (NVDA-US) 晶片，消息激勵輝達股價週三 (6 日) 收盤喜升逾 3%，AMD 則慘崩逾 7%。
馬斯克在法說會上表示，SpaceX 經過評估後，認為輝達的 Vera Rubin 架構是目前最優秀的 AI 運算平台，因此公司未來 AI 系統將「完全建立在輝達平台之上」，雙方也將持續深化合作。
他透露，SpaceX 預計今年底 AI 運算能力將突破 2GW，到 2027 年底進一步擴大至接近 10GW。公司也計畫自明年起部署 Starmind 衛星網路，並把輝達 Vera Rubin NVL72 機櫃系統同時應用於地面與太空資料中心。
馬斯克指出，相較於地面資料中心，太空資料中心不需大量土地，且可利用太空環境降低散熱需求，因此具備長期發展潛力。不過，如何將大型 AI 伺服器成功送入軌道並完成部署與連線，仍將面臨不小的技術挑戰。
SpaceX 同時公布最新 AI 業務表現。受惠於雲端服務合作案，以及 Grok 與 X 訂閱業務持續成長，公司 AI 業務營收達 26 億美元，較前一季大增 213%，年增 247%。
此外，SpaceX 已與 Google、Anthropic 簽署總額達數十億美元的資料中心租賃協議，未來將提供 AI 運算容量，支援兩家公司擴大人工智慧服務。
相較之下，AMD 雖繳出優於市場預期的第二季成績單，仍難掩市場失望情緒。
AMD 第二季營收 115.4 億美元、調整後每股盈餘 1.66 美元，均優於市場預估。其中，資料中心營收攀升至歷史新高 67 億美元，占總營收比重提高至 58%，主要受 EPYC 處理器與 Instinct AI GPU 出貨帶動；客戶端與遊戲事業營收則為 38.4 億美元，年增約 6%。
展望後市，AMD 預估第三季營收約 130 億美元 (上下浮動 3 億美元)，高於市場預估的 125.1 億美元，意味著年增約 41%、季增約 13%。
執行長蘇姿丰表示，公司下半年營運動能持續增強，EPYC 需求加速成長、Instinct 部署持續擴大，Helios 平台也將開始放量，AI 正推動各項運算需求快速提升。
她指出，AMD 近期已取得多項大型 AI 基礎設施合作案，包括 Anthropic、Meta 及 Core Scientific 等客戶，並將 2030 年 CPU 市場規模預估上修至超過 2,000 億美元，目標拿下逾 50% 市占率，同時預估明年伺服器業務營收將成長超過 70%。
部分華爾街分析師認為，儘管 AMD 展望依舊強勁，但市場原本期待公司在 AI 晶片業務能出現更快速的成長，因此財測未完全滿足投資人對短期爆發力的期待；再加上馬斯克宣布 SpaceX 將 AI 基礎設施全面轉向輝達，也進一步打擊市場情緒，拖累 AMD 股價大幅回落。
paras_en: SpaceX's first earnings call since going public unexpectedly became the focus of the AI chip market. CEO Elon Musk announced that SpaceX's AI infrastructure will fully adopt NVIDIA (NVDA-US) chips in the future, which sparked a surge of over 3% in NVIDIA's stock price on Wednesday (6th), while AMD plummeted over 7%.

Musk stated at the earnings call that after evaluation, SpaceX believes NVIDIA's Vera Rubin architecture is the most excellent AI computation platform currently, and the company's future AI systems will "completely be built on the NVIDIA platform", with both parties continuing to deepen their cooperation.

He revealed that SpaceX expects its AI computation capacity to break through 2GW by the end of the year and further expand to nearly 10GW by the end of 2027. The company also plans to deploy the Starmind satellite network from next year and apply the NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 server system simultaneously to both ground and space data centers.

Musk pointed out that compared to ground data centers, space data centers do not require large amounts of land and can utilize the space environment to reduce heat dissipation requirements, thus having long-term development potential. However, how to successfully send large AI servers into orbit and complete deployment and connection will still face significant technical challenges.

SpaceX also announced its latest AI business performance. Benefiting from cloud service cooperation and the continued growth of Grok and X subscription businesses, the company's AI business revenue reached $2.6 billion, a 213% increase from the previous quarter and a 247% increase from the previous year.

In addition, SpaceX has signed a data center rental agreement with Google and Anthropic worth tens of billions of dollars, which will provide AI computation capacity to support the expansion of the two companies' artificial intelligence services.
In contrast, AMD, despite submitting a better-than-expected second-quarter earnings report, was unable to alleviate market disappointment.

AMD's second-quarter revenue was $11.54 billion, with adjusted earnings per share of $1.66, both of which were better than market estimates. Among them, data center revenue rose to a historical high of $6.7 billion, accounting for 58% of total revenue, mainly driven by the shipment of EPYC processors and Instinct AI GPUs; client and gaming business revenue was $3.84 billion, a 6% increase from the previous year.

Looking ahead, AMD estimates third-quarter revenue of approximately $13 billion (with a 3 billion dollar range), higher than market estimates of $12.51 billion, indicating a 41% increase from the previous year and a 13% increase from the previous quarter.

CEO Lisa Su stated that the company's second-half operating momentum will continue to strengthen, with EPYC demand accelerating growth, Instinct deployment continuing to expand, and the Helios platform starting to ramp up, with AI driving rapid increases in various computation demands.

She pointed out that AMD has recently secured several large-scale AI infrastructure cooperation agreements, including Anthropic, Meta, and Core Scientific, and will upgrade its 2030 CPU market size estimate to over $200 billion, aiming to capture over 50% market share, while also estimating that server business revenue will grow over 70% next year.

Some Wall Street analysts believe that although AMD's outlook remains strong, the market originally expected the company's AI chip business to show faster growth, and the earnings report did not fully meet investors' expectations for short-term explosive power; in addition, Musk's announcement that SpaceX will fully transition its AI infrastructure to NVIDIA has further dampened market sentiment, dragging AMD's stock price down sharply.

items.title: AI熱潮早已見頂？「估值教父」警告：真正危險的不是七巨頭而是「這類」AI股票
items.title_en: Has the AI Boom Already Peaked? Valuation Guru Warns the Real Danger Lies Not in the Magnificent Seven but in These Types of AI Stocks
paras: 紐約大學史登商學院財務金融教授、有「估值教父」之稱的達摩德仁（Aswath Damodaran），近日再度對人工智慧（AI）類股投資人提出警告，指出市場恐怕早已在數月前觸及「AI高峰」，而其中「一部分」的股票未來走勢尤其令人擔憂。
根據《Business Insider》報導，部分AI相關股票近期已出現明顯拋售潮，資金開始轉向其他板塊。
整個7月期間，投資人大舉撤出記憶體與半導體類股。Roundhill DRAM ETF(DRAM-US) 自近期高點以來已下跌36%，而安碩半導體ETF(SOXX-US) 也較近期高點回落22%。
達摩德仁表示：「我認為AI熱潮早在幾個月前就已達到高峰，未來幾個月市場將出現更多整併與修正。」
他並指出，當AI產業迎來洗牌時，真正危險的並非「美股七巨頭」（Magnificent Seven），而是規模較小的AI公司。
達摩德仁解釋稱，基於AI投資主題中的中小型企業缺乏足夠的財務緩衝，一旦AI投資熱潮進一步降溫，將更難承受隨之而來的市場修正，並面臨更大的壓力
近期，隨著投資人重新回補先前遭到拋售的科技股，AI概念股已開始反彈。在市場風險偏好回升帶動下，資金重新流向科技股，道瓊工業指數與標普500指數本週雙雙創下歷史新高。
不過，達摩德仁認為，這波漲勢主要是受到「害怕錯過」（FOMO）情緒驅動，而非企業基本面改善所支撐。
他表示：「投資人心態就是，『現在終於有機會買進AI公司了。』我不會把這件事解讀得更複雜。」
談到投入AI資本支出最多的超大規模雲端服務商時，達摩德仁形容它們是AI產業中「最具防禦力」的一群企業，因為擁有充沛的現金流，也具備承擔大量負債的能力。
儘管如此，他仍對大型AI企業的前景提出警告，指出這些公司正背負愈來愈多債務，但AI資本支出的投資報酬率仍偏低。
達摩德仁指出：「除非它們開始交出與數百億美元資本支出相匹配的獲利表現，否則這些公司未來將演變成截然不同的企業。」
他進一步稱：「這本身沒有問題，但我認為投資人尚未習慣投資一家資本密集度更高的公司所伴隨的風險。」
達摩德仁過去亦曾多次警告，部分AI概念股的估值可能過高。早在2023年，他便指出，輝達(NVDA-US) 的股價從估值角度來看已嚴重偏高，並估計該公司當時的合理價值約僅為市價的一半。
paras_en: New York University Stern School of Business finance professor Aswath Damodaran, known as the “valuation guru,” recently warned AI‑related stock investors that the market may have hit the AI peak months ago, and that a “subset” of those stocks face especially concerning outlooks.
According to Business Insider, some AI‑related stocks have recently experienced a noticeable sell‑off as capital shifts to other sectors.

Throughout July, investors massively withdrew from memory‑chip and semiconductor stocks. The Roundhill DRAM ETF (DRAM‑US) has fallen 36% from its recent high, and the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX‑US) is down 22% from its recent peak.
Damodaran said, “I think the AI hype peaked several months ago, and the market will see more consolidation and correction over the next few months.”
He added that when the AI industry reshuffles, the real danger is not the “Magnificent Seven” U.S. stocks but smaller‑cap AI companies.

Damodaran explained that mid‑ and small‑cap firms in the AI theme lack sufficient financial buffers, so a cooling of the AI hype would make it harder for them to withstand the ensuing market correction and increase pressure on them.

Recently, as investors re‑entered previously sold‑off tech stocks, AI concept stocks have begun to rebound. With renewed risk appetite, capital is flowing back into tech, and both the Dow Jones Industrial Average and the S&P 500 hit all‑time highs this week.
However, Damodaran believes this rally is driven mainly by fear‑of‑missing‑out (FOMO) rather than improvements in company fundamentals.
He said, “The investor mindset is, ‘Now finally there’s a chance to buy AI companies.’ I won’t read anything more complicated into that.”

When discussing the ultra‑large cloud service providers that spend the most on AI capital expenditures, Damodaran described them as the “most defensive” group in the AI industry because they have abundant cash flow and the capacity to take on substantial debt.
Nonetheless, he cautioned that even large AI firms face growing debt loads while the return on AI cap‑ex remains low.
Damodaran noted, “Unless they start delivering earnings that match the hundreds of billions of dollars in cap‑ex, these companies will evolve into very different businesses.”
He added, “That in itself isn’t a problem, but I think investors aren’t yet accustomed to the risks of investing in a more capital‑intensive company.”

Damodaran has repeatedly warned that some AI concept stocks may be overvalued. As early as 2023, he pointed out that Nvidia (NVDA‑US) was severely overvalued from a valuation perspective, estimating its fair value at roughly half of its market price at the time.

items.title: 財報優預期仍難救股價 威騰電子盤後重挫10%
items.title_en: Better-Than-Expected Earnings Still Can't Save the Stock; Western Digital Plunges Over 10% After Hours
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，威騰電子 (Western Digital)(WDC-US) 周三 (5 日) 公布優於預期的最新一季財報，但由於財測未能滿足市場高度期待，盤後股價仍重挫。截至發稿，跌逾 10%。
此次盤後賣壓也凸顯，在 AI 熱潮帶動下，市場對相關供應鏈業者的期待已大幅提高。
在公布財報前，威騰電子股價今年以來已累計大漲 201%。
儘管財報顯示，AI 供應鏈對資料儲存的需求仍持續成長，但投資人對公司相對保守的財測反應冷淡，也反映市場仍擔憂 AI 需求未來可能放緩。
威騰電子 2026 會計年度第四季調整後每股盈餘 (EPS) 為 3.56 美元，優於 FactSet 統計分析師預估的 3.31 美元。當季營收達 37.5 億美元，較去年同期成長 42%，也高於華爾街預估的 37 億美元。
不過，公司對本季展望僅算穩健，未能帶來太大驚喜。
威騰電子預估，本季 (第一季) 營收將達 41 億美元，上下浮動 1 億美元。調整後每股盈餘預估介於 3.85 美元至 4.15 美元。分析師原先預估本季營收約 40.6 億美元，調整後每股盈餘為 3.84 美元。
此外，威騰電子此次財測優於市場預期的幅度，也不如競爭對手希捷科技 (Seagate Technology)(STX-US) 上周公布財報時所釋出的展望來得強勁。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that Western Digital (WDC-US) posted a quarterly earnings report on Wednesday (the 5th) that beat expectations, but because its outlook failed to meet the market's high hopes, the stock fell sharply after hours, down more than 10% at the time of publication.
The after‑hours selling pressure also highlights how the AI boom has dramatically raised expectations for companies in the related supply chain.
Before the earnings release, Western Digital's stock had already rallied 201% year‑to‑date.

Although the results showed that AI‑related demand for data storage continues to grow, investors reacted lukewarm to the company's relatively conservative guidance, reflecting lingering market concerns that AI demand could slow in the future.

For the fourth quarter of its 2026 fiscal year, Western Digital reported adjusted earnings per share (EPS) of $3.56, ahead of FactSet analysts' consensus estimate of $3.31. Quarterly revenue came in at $3.75 billion, up 42% from the same period last year and above Wall Street's forecast of $3.7 billion.
However, the company's outlook for the coming quarter was only modest, offering little surprise.

Western Digital projects first‑quarter revenue of about $4.1 billion, give or take $100 million, and adjusted EPS in the range of $3.85 to $4.15. Analysts had previously expected revenue of roughly $4.06 billion and adjusted EPS of $3.84.
Moreover, the degree to which Western Digital's guidance beat market expectations was less impressive than the outlook Seagate Technology (STX-US) gave when it released its earnings last week.

items.title: 蘋果向長鑫壓價LPDDR5X遭拒！中國國產DRAM首現「不給果鏈打折」反轉
items.title_en: Apple’s Price‑Cut Request for LPDDR5X Rejected by CXMT! China’s Domestic DRAM Shows Its First “No Discount for Apple Supply Chain” Reversal
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，為緩解下一代 iPhone 與智慧裝置 BOM 成本壓力，蘋果近期就 LPDDR5X 等行動 DRAM 供貨價與長鑫存儲 (CXMT) 談判，要求比照過往「果鏈」慣例讓利，卻遭直接回絕，後者堅持報價不低於三星、SK 海力士，甚至持平或略高。
韓媒《Digital Daily》報導，供應商過去擠進果鏈即等於數年穩單，被剔除往往伴隨數十億美元損失，議價空間極小，但 AI 伺服器與 HBM 需求爆發改寫規則，三星、海力士產能轉向高附加價值 AI 記憶體，通用 DRAM 供給收緊，而華為、小米、騰訊、阿里雲、字節跳動等已用長期合約協議 (LTA) 鎖定長鑫產能，中國安卓陣營 LPDDR5X 滲透率快速拉升，長鑫不需要為換蘋果訂單降價。
今年 6 月，蘋果已因記憶體漲價調升 iPad、Mac 售價，並傳向華府遊說准採長鑫晶片，如今價格門檻反成自身成本難題。
產能面是長鑫底氣來源。合肥、北京 3 座 12 吋廠月產 28 萬—30 萬片，利用率 95% 以上，今年底預計衝 35 萬片，逼近美光同期 38.5 萬片，遠期目標 60 萬片，2030 年前後規模有望超越美光。
長鑫科技上周一 (7 月 27 日) 登陸 A 股科創板，首日漲 465.82%、市值破 3 兆登頂 A 股，8 月 5 日收 54.30 元、市值 3.63 兆元，今年 Q2 全球 DRAM 市佔 7%、營收年增 716%，成為 Counterpoint 榜單增長最快供應商。
這場談判破裂的意義不在於單筆訂單，而在權力位移。中國記憶體廠從「求果鏈施捨份額」轉為「國內 AI 與手機需求優先」，蘋果首次在基礎零件上碰到「不給折扣」的中國國產 IDM 廠商。消費電子漲價週期疊加 AI 資本開支搶料，下游品牌廠今後要習慣的是，記憶體不再是最易被砍價的類別。
paras_en: According to the latest foreign media reports, to ease the bill‑of‑materials cost pressure for next‑generation iPhones and other smart devices, Apple recently negotiated with CXMT (ChangXin Memory Technologies) over the supply price of LPDDR5X and other mobile DRAM, asking for the usual concessions that Apple’s supply chain has historically received. CXMT flatly refused, insisting that its pricing would not be lower than Samsung’s or SK Hynix’s, and might even be on par with or slightly higher.

South Korean outlet Digital Daily noted that suppliers that manage to get into Apple’s supply chain historically enjoy multi‑year guaranteed orders, and being cut out often means losses of tens of billions of dollars, leaving little room for bargaining. However, the explosion in demand for AI servers and HBM has reshaped the rules: Samsung and Hynix are shifting capacity toward high‑value‑add AI memory, tightening the supply of commodity DRAM. Meanwhile, companies such as Huawei, Xiaomi, Tencent, Alibaba Cloud and ByteDance have locked in CXMT capacity through long‑term agreements (LTAs). As a result, the penetration of LPDDR5X in China’s Android ecosystem is rising quickly, and CXMT does not need to lower its price to win Apple’s business.

In June this year, Apple raised the prices of iPads and Macs because of memory price hikes and reportedly lobbied Washington to approve the use of CXMT chips. Now the price hurdle has become a cost problem for Apple itself.

CXMT’s production capacity underpins its confidence. Its three 12‑inch fabs in Hefei and Beijing each produce 280,000‑300,000 wafers per month, with utilization above 95%. By the end of this year the company expects to reach 350,000 wafers, close to Micron’s 385,000‑wafer output for the same period. Its long‑term target is 600,000 wafers, and it could surpass Micron’s scale around 2030.

CXMT went public on China’s STAR Market on Monday, July 27, soaring 465.82% on the first day and pushing its market value past 3 trillion yuan, the highest on the A‑share market. On August 5 it closed at 54.30 yuan, with a market cap of 3.63 trillion yuan. In Q2 2024 the company held a 7% share of the global DRAM market, with revenue up 716% year‑over‑year, making it the fastest‑growing supplier on Counterpoint’s list.

The significance of the broken negotiation lies not in a single order but in a shift of power. Chinese memory makers have moved from “seeking a share of Apple’s supply chain” to “prioritising domestic AI and smartphone demand.” This is the first time Apple has encountered a Chinese IDM supplier that refuses to give a discount on a core component. With consumer‑electronics price‑rise cycles overlapping AI‑driven capital spending for chips, downstream brands will have to get used to memory no longer being the easiest category to bargain down.

items.title_en: Liwei Files for Bankruptcy to Cut Arbitration Impact; Weixun (3032) Relieves Financial Burden, Stock Soars to Upper Limit
paras: 2026年08月05日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 偉訓(3032-TW)旗下持股78%的子公司力韡，因與美國客戶Ascion的產品瑕疵仲裁案，董事會決議自8月18日起停業一年，並向法院聲請破產。公司表示，待法院完成破產程序並指派破產管理人後，力韡將退出偉訓合併財務報表，先前超額認列逾11億元的損失可望回沖，未來也不再認列力韡虧損。消息激勵偉訓股價開高後，4分鐘內即攻上漲停。
這起爭議始於2021年。力韡原為美國電動床品牌REVERIE母公司Ascion的供應商，Ascion以產品瑕疵及出貨延遲為由提出仲裁。案件歷經多年審理及三次仲裁，最終判定力韡須賠償約4,859萬美元（約新台幣15.76億元），包括產品損害、利息及律師費等。
力韡曾向美國密西根東區聯邦地方法院提起撤銷仲裁裁決之訴，但於7月23日遭駁回。由於資產不足以清償賠償金，因此董事會決議停業並向法院聲請破產。
這起仲裁案之前一直拖累偉訓。雖然美國法院日前已裁定，仲裁責任僅限於力韡，不會向上擴及母公司偉訓，但由於力韡一直納入偉訓合併財務報表，偉訓仍須認列相關損失，導致2025會計年度由前一年度每股盈餘4.61元轉為每股稅後虧損7.93元，並決定不配發股利。
如今隨著力韡啟動破產程序，待法院完成程序並指派破產管理人後，力韡將不再納入合併財務報表。偉訓表示，先前超額認列逾11億元的損失可望回沖，未來也無須再認列力韡虧損，市場認為有助於公司擺脫多年來的財務包袱。
儘管仲裁案重創獲利，偉訓本業仍維持成長。2025會計年度合併營收111.89億元，年增率51%，營業利益10.16億元，年增率110%，主要受惠於併購珀韻（AIP）帶動聲學業務，以及AI伺服器相關產品布局。展望2026年，公司將持續推動AI伺服器機櫃、ASIC散熱模組及高瓦數電源等產品放量出貨，作為未來成長動能。

paras_en: August 5, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Weixun (3032‑TW) subsidiary Liwei, which holds 78% of the shares, decided to suspend operations for one year starting August 18 and filed for bankruptcy after an arbitration case with U.S. client Ascion over product defects. The company said that once the court completes the bankruptcy process and appoints a trustee, Liwei will be removed from Weixun’s consolidated financial statements, allowing the previously over‑recorded loss of more than NT$1.1 billion to be reversed and no further Liwei losses will be recognized. The news spurred the stock to open higher and hit the daily price limit within four minutes.

The dispute dates back to 2021. Liwei was originally a supplier for Ascion, the parent of U.S. electric‑bed brand REVERIE. Ascion initiated arbitration citing product defects and delayed shipments. After years of litigation and three arbitration rounds, the final award required Liwei to pay about US$48.59 million (approximately NT$1.576 billion), covering product damages, interest and legal fees.

Liwei had sued the Eastern District of Michigan Federal Court to overturn the arbitration award, but the suit was dismissed on July 23. Because its assets are insufficient to cover the compensation, the board resolved to cease operations and file for bankruptcy.

The arbitration case had been dragging on Weixun’s results. Although a U.S. court recently ruled that liability is limited to Liwei and does not extend to the parent Weixun, Liwei’s inclusion in the consolidated statements forced Weixun to record the loss, turning the 2025 earnings per share from a profit of NT$4.61 in the prior year to a post‑tax loss of NT$7.93 and prompting a dividend suspension.

Now that Liwei has entered bankruptcy, once the court finalizes the process and appoints a trustee, Liwei will be excluded from the consolidated statements. Weixun said the previously over‑recorded loss of more than NT$1.1 billion can be reversed and no future Liwei losses will be recognized, which the market sees as freeing the company from a long‑standing financial burden.

Despite the hit to profitability from the arbitration, Weixun’s core business continues to grow. For the 2025 fiscal year, consolidated revenue reached NT$111.89 billion, up 51% year‑on‑year, and operating profit was NT$10.16 billion, up 110%, driven mainly by the acquisition of AIP (Pearl Sound) boosting acoustic business and the rollout of AI server products. Looking ahead to 2026, the company will keep scaling shipments of AI server racks, ASIC cooling modules and high‑wattage power supplies as future growth engines.

paras: 環宇 - KY(4991-TW) 今 (5) 日舉行法說會，受惠於 AI 資料中心，帶動公司在光電晶圓代工與自有品牌光電元件 (AOC) 需求強勁，訂單能見度可看到今 (2026) 年年底，全年出貨展望樂觀。此外，針對傳聞美國川普即將禁止進口新型的中國製光收發器，環宇 - KY 總執行長兼總裁安寶信也指出，若能禁止中國進口，對於環宇 - KY 未來營運將有加分效果。
環宇 - KY 今日舉行線上法說會，也公告第 2 季財報，環宇 - KY 第 2 季營收為 7.7 億元、季增 7.8%、年增 57.2%；單季毛利率為 43.3%、季減 11.2 個百分比、年減 5.5 個百分比；稅後純益為 1.1 億元、季減 43.8%、年增達 672%，單季 EPS 為 0.92 元。

會中也有法人提問，環宇 - KY 第 2 季毛利率掉到 43.3%、減少 12.2% 原因。安寶信表示，主要是產品組合變化及 AOC 的產量下降，第 2 季產品占比觀察，射頻晶圓代工約 23%，光電晶圓代工約 10%，AOC61%，其他 6%，上半年稅後純益為 3 億元，較去年同期由虧轉盈，上半年 EPS 為 2.58 元。
此外，針對外電報載，川普即將禁止中國製造的資料中心光收發模組進入美國，引發中國廠商中際旭創受影響。安寶信也對此回應，因環宇 - KY 生產地點就在美國，若美系客戶要向外採購下，對環宇 - KY 來說有望成為一大契機及後市營運。
paras_en: Universal Optoelectronics (KY) (4991‑TW) held its earnings briefing today (the 5th). Benefiting from AI data centers, the company sees strong demand for its photonic wafer foundry services and its own‑brand optoelectronic components (AOC), with order visibility extending to the end of 2026 and an optimistic full‑year shipment outlook. In response to rumors that the United States under President Trump will soon ban imports of new Chinese‑made optical transceivers, CEO and President An Baoxin noted that such a ban would be a plus for Universal’s future operations.

Universal conducted an online briefing today and also released its Q2 financial results. Q2 revenue was NT$770 million, up 7.8% quarter‑over‑quarter and 57.2% year‑over‑year. The quarterly gross margin was 43.3%, down 11.2 percentage points QoQ and 5.5 points YoY. Net profit after tax was NT$110 million, down 43.8% QoQ but up 672% YoY, with earnings per share of NT$0.92 for the quarter.

An said that for Q3, besides continued revenue growth, the company expects gross margins to stay in the 44%‑48% range. Operating expenses are currently about US$7.5‑8.5 million. Existing orders can be seen through year‑end, but a shortage of indium phosphide (InP) substrates is constraining capacity. However, the company’s material inventory looks sufficient through the end of this year, and it will keep contacting suppliers in other countries next year to resolve the raw‑material issue.

During the session, an institutional investor asked why Q2 gross margin fell to 43.3%, a 12.2‑point decline. An explained that the drop was mainly due to a shift in product mix and a reduction in AOC production. In Q2, product composition was roughly: RF wafer foundry 23%, photonic wafer foundry 10%, AOC 61%, and other 6%. For the first half of the year, net profit after tax was NT$300 million, turning a loss into a profit year‑over‑year, and H1 EPS was NT$2.58.

Regarding reports that the Trump administration will ban Chinese‑made data‑center optical transceiver modules from entering the United States, which could affect Chinese supplier Zhongji Xuchuang, An responded that Universal’s production sites are located in the U.S. If American customers need to source abroad, this could become a major opportunity for Universal’s future operations.

items.title_en: Taiwan's 2027 Budget for Science and Technology Reaches NT$182.3 Billion, Highest in History
paras: 明 (2027) 年度中央總預算案已籌編完成，國科會主委吳誠文今 (5) 日表示，明年科技預算再創新高，達新台幣 1,823 億元，較今 (2026) 年成長約 9.47%，重點包括加碼投入主權 AI 算力與基礎建設，打造智慧國家 2.0，並藉由科技產業優勢帶動中小微企業轉型與 AI 化。
吳誠文表示，台灣雖然已經具有半導體與 AI 硬體產業的深厚實力，然而強敵環伺不能掉以輕心，必須持續不斷提升科技研發實力及國際競爭力。在全球地緣政治局勢與 AI 科技競合之際，台灣除了強化半導體與 AI 產業優勢以鞏固科技戰略地位及經濟繁榮之外，也正面臨產業結構轉型的關鍵階段，應該要藉科技產業優勢帶動社會各行各業繁榮。
吳誠文說明，雖然今 (2026) 年的中央總預算還在立法院討論，但行政院已經完成了明年總預算的規劃，明年科技預算將創新高來到 1,823 億元，相較於今年成長約 9.47%，其中最重要的是主權 AI 算力與基礎建設加碼投入，打造智慧國家 2.0，並藉科技產業優勢帶動中小微企業轉型與 AI 化，促進社會各行業全面繁榮。
吳誠文強調，明年行政院科技預算，首先要保障基礎學術研究穩定成長，並重點投入全球競逐的高效能運算、量子科技、智慧機器人、矽光子與光通訊、主權 AI 等「AI 新十大建設」關鍵科技及「五大信賴產業」關鍵科技。
吳誠文指出，例如：一、大南方新矽谷 84 億，加速建構南台灣 AI 產業生態系；二、 晶創台灣 207 億，落實「優勢延續、國際拓展、應用創新、永續調適」四大半導體政策支柱與產業技術布局；三、次世代通訊 4 億，掌握低軌通訊衛星產業發展契機，建構 6G 通訊產業優勢；四、智慧機器人 22 億，推動智慧機器人研發與產業生態系建構。
五、太空計畫三期 69 億，發展低軌通訊衛星與前瞻遙測衛星系統，建構國際太空產業合作契機；六、海洋科技方案 22 億，發展科技以推動海域安全科技化、海洋產業智慧化、海洋文化生活化；七、淨零科技 108 億，發展淨零與碳循環科技，推動實際場域驗證及社區實作以加速產業化；高齡科技 16 億元，推動高齡科技研發、應用服務系統開發、場域驗證、產業化等。
吳誠文指出，明年起行政院也將整合中央各部會能量推動「智慧國家 2.0」計畫，與地方政府合作把 AI 科技轉化為社會各行各業 AI 化的應用，進一步讓智慧化的中小微企業蓬勃發展，邁向全民智慧生活圈。
paras_en: The 2027 central government budget has been completed, and National Science Council (NSC) Chairman Wu Ching-wen announced on May 5 that the budget for science and technology will reach a new high of NT$182.3 billion, a 9.47% increase from last year. The focus will be on investing in sovereign AI computing power and infrastructure, creating a smart nation 2.0, and using technology industry advantages to drive the transformation and AI of small and medium-sized enterprises.

Wu Ching-wen pointed out that although Taiwan has a deep foundation in semiconductor and AI hardware industries, it cannot be complacent with the strong competition surrounding it. It must continue to improve its technological research and development capabilities and international competitiveness. In the context of global geopolitics and AI technology competition, Taiwan not only needs to strengthen its semiconductor and AI industry advantages to consolidate its technological strategic position and economic prosperity, but also faces a critical stage of industrial structural transformation.

Wu Ching-wen explained that although the 2026 central government budget is still being discussed in the Legislative Yuan, the Executive Yuan has completed the planning for next year's budget. Next year's science and technology budget will reach a new high of NT$182.3 billion, a 9.47% increase from this year. The most important thing is to invest in sovereign AI computing power and infrastructure, create a smart nation 2.0, and use technology industry advantages to drive the transformation and AI of small and medium-sized enterprises, promoting the overall prosperity of various industries.

Wu Ching-wen emphasized that next year's Executive Yuan science and technology budget will first ensure the stable growth of basic academic research and focus on investing in key technologies such as high-performance computing, quantum technology, intelligent robots, silicon photonics and optical communication, and sovereign AI. The "AI New Ten Major Construction" and "Five Major Trust Industries" key technologies will also be prioritized.

Wu Ching-wen pointed out that, for example, one is the South Taiwan AI Industry Ecosystem Construction Project, which will invest NT$84 billion to accelerate the construction of the AI industry ecosystem in southern Taiwan. Two is the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) project, which will invest NT$207 billion to implement the "Continuation of Advantage, International Expansion, Innovation, and Sustainable Adaptation" four-pillar semiconductor policy and industry technology layout.

Wu Ching-wen pointed out that, for example, one is the Next-Generation Communication Project, which will invest NT$4 billion to grasp the opportunity of low-orbit communication satellite industry development, build a 6G communication industry advantage. Two is the Intelligent Robot Project, which will invest NT$22 billion to promote the development of intelligent robots and the construction of the robot industry ecosystem.

Wu Ching-wen pointed out that, for example, one is the Space Plan Phase 3, which will invest NT$69 billion to develop low-orbit communication satellites and advanced remote sensing satellite systems, build international space industry cooperation opportunities. Two is the Ocean Technology Scheme, which will invest NT$22 billion to develop technology to promote ocean security, ocean industry intelligence, and ocean cultural living. Three is the Zero-Carbon Technology Project, which will invest NT$108 billion to develop zero-carbon and carbon cycle technologies, promote practical field verification and community implementation to accelerate industrialization.

Wu Ching-wen pointed out that, for example, one is the Aging Technology Project, which will invest NT$16 billion to promote aging technology research and development, application service system development, field verification, and industrialization.

items.title: 氣立2026年上半年轉盈稅後賺進4803萬元每股純益0.69元
items.title_en: LIT 2026 First Half Year Turned Profit After Tax of NT$48.03 Million Per Share, Net Profit of NT$0.69 Per Share
paras: 氣動與電控自動化元件廠氣立 (4555-TW) 今 (5) 日公布最新獲利，2026 年第二季稅後賺 4549 萬元，季增 16.91 倍，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益 0.65 元， 上半年稅後賺進 4803 萬元，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益 0.69 元。
氣立 2026 年第二季營收 4.92 億元，毛利率 32.95%，季增 2.82 個百分點，年增 0.87 個百分點，第二季稅後賺 4549 萬元，季增 16.91 倍，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益 0.65 元。上半年稅後賺進 4803 萬元，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益爲 0.69 元。

氣立主管指出，以精密金屬製造為主的浙江平湖廠，受惠於 AI 興起所帶動 PCB 產業等生產設備需求增加，且機器人相關零組件訂單持續增長，加上歐洲客戶上半年度需求開始回溫，原有汽車與農機等業務亦維持平穩，使精密金屬製造業績始終維持相對高檔水準；而氣動及電控元件部分，由於台北廠與經銷商合力接獲半導體封測廠專案訂單、上海廠在大陸農業機械、液冷相關設備、新能源與儲能等業務開發有成下，整體營收也較去年同期提升；伴隨者泰國廠今年起正式投入貢獻集團營收；使上半年度營運增長。
氣立除了營收維持增長外，近年來積極推動的產品優化設計及產能重新配置計畫也見到成效，不但有效降低生產成本與提升效率外，更直接反映在毛利率上，從去年第二季起回升至 30% 以上，至今年第二季更近 33%。
在新產業及新產品開發上，氣立上半年在半導體封測專案訂單挹注與既有客戶持續下單下，相關無桿缸等產品出貨增長，半導體產業客群營收占比提升；至於超音波流量感測器部分，客戶驗證時間較原先預期長，但經過不斷測試與產品修正，從第二季末起也開始由原先測試訂單轉變為小額正式訂單，客群也由半導體廠務及 PCB 拓展至水資源，生技等產業，逐漸有效轉化為營收。
paras_en: LIT (4555-TW) announced its latest earnings today (5th), with a net profit of NT$45.49 million in the second quarter, a 16.91 times increase from the same period last year, with a net profit of NT$0.65 per share. The company's revenue for the first half of 2026 was NT$492 million, with a gross margin of 32.95%, a 2.82 percentage point increase from the same period last year, and a net profit of NT$48.03 million, a 16.91 times increase from the same period last year, with a net profit of NT$0.69 per share.

LIT's management pointed out that the company's precision metal manufacturing business in Zhejiang Pinghu, which is mainly focused on AI-driven PCB production equipment and machine-related component orders, has seen a significant increase in demand, and the company's European customers have started to see a rebound in demand in the first half of the year, while the company's existing automotive and agricultural machinery businesses have maintained a stable performance, resulting in a relatively high level of performance in the precision metal manufacturing industry.

In addition, the company's pneumatic and electrical control components business has seen a significant increase in revenue due to the joint efforts of the Taipei factory and distributors to receive semiconductor packaging factory project orders, and the Shanghai factory has seen significant growth in agricultural machinery, liquid cooling-related equipment, new energy, and energy storage businesses, resulting in a significant increase in revenue compared to the same period last year.
The company's Thai factory has officially started contributing to the group's revenue this year, resulting in a significant increase in revenue in the first half of the year.

In addition to revenue growth, the company's product optimization design and capacity reconfiguration plan, which has been actively promoted in recent years, has also seen significant results, not only effectively reducing production costs and improving efficiency, but also directly reflected in the gross margin, which has risen to over 30% since last year's second quarter, and reached 33% in the second quarter of this year.

In terms of new industries and new product development, LIT has seen significant growth in revenue from its semiconductor packaging project orders and existing customers' continued orders, with related products such as no-cylinder products seeing increased shipments, and the semiconductor industry customer group's revenue proportion increasing.

As for the ultrasonic flow sensor part, the customer verification time was longer than expected, but after continuous testing and product modification, it started to convert from testing orders to small formal orders from the end of the second quarter, and the customer group expanded from semiconductor factories and PCBs to water resources, biotechnology, and other industries, gradually converting into revenue.

items.title: 驗32次全合格！台糖受波及自主下架估損2.43億元 喊告福懋求償
items.title_en: Passed All 32 Tests! Taiwan Sugar Sues Fu Mao for Estimated NT$243 Million Loss After Unfair Delisting
paras: 台糖今 (5) 日表示，針對今年 5 月向福懋（1225-TW）來自中聯的粗油，因中聯油品發生苯胼芘超標情事，連帶導致台糖商品無辜下架、商譽受損，保守估計光是沙拉油商品損失就高達 2.43 億元。台糖澄清，公司向來嚴格落實自主品管，今年以來沙拉油產品經主管機關及相關單位檢驗 32 次全部合格，部分民代與媒體稱其為毒油與事實不符。台糖目前正委請律師與會計師研商，將正式向福懋提告求償。
台糖指出，公司今年 5 月向福懋公司採購粗油，雖然均依據合約規範辦理規格檢驗，並將檢測結果與契約不符的粗油直接拒收，但福懋所提供來自中聯公司的油源，事後卻被驗出苯胼芘超標，進而引發市場疑慮與爭議。這項外購原料問題致使台糖產品遭受無妄之災，不僅面臨產品下架命運，更有形與無形地重創公司建立多年的商譽與品牌形象。
為了正視聽並維護權益，台糖重申公司對產品品質經營的堅持，強調從今年初至今，台糖沙拉油已累計接受各界抽驗多達 32 次，檢驗結果每次均安全過關，完全符合衛生標準。對於部分外界民代與媒體頻繁以毒油形容台糖產品，台糖對此表達遺憾與無奈，並呼籲外界勿再以訛傳訛，協助導正市場資訊。
針對後續法律行動與求償作業，台糖說明，內部目前已著手進行相關損失評估。初步保守估算，光是沙拉油產品下架與銷售停擺所產生的直接經濟損失，就至少達到 2.43 億元，至於商譽等無形損失金額則尚在精算評估中。台糖後續將儘快與律師及會計師進行研商，完成整體損失清算後，會正式向福懋公司提出告訴並爭取合法賠償。
paras_en: Taiwan Sugar announced today (May 5) that the crude oil it purchased in May from Fu Mao (1225‑TW), sourced from Zhonglian, was found to exceed the benzopyrene limit. This contamination forced Taiwan Sugar's products to be unjustly removed from shelves and damaged its goodwill, with a conservative estimate that losses from its salad oil alone total NT$243 million. Taiwan Sugar clarified that it has always strictly enforced independent quality control; since the start of the year its salad oil has been tested 32 times by regulators and related agencies, all passing, and it disputes claims by some legislators and media that the oil is poisonous.

The company noted that it purchased the crude oil from Fu Mao in May, conducting specification inspections as required by contract and rejecting any oil that did not meet the terms. However, the oil supplied by Fu Mao from Zhonglian was later found to contain excessive benzopyrene, sparking market concerns and controversy. This external raw‑material issue caused Taiwan Sugar’s products to suffer an unwarranted disaster, leading not only to product delisting but also to both tangible and intangible damage to the goodwill and brand image built over years.

To address the situation and protect its rights, Taiwan Sugar reiterated its commitment to product quality, emphasizing that since the beginning of the year its salad oil has undergone up to 32 random inspections, each passing safely and fully complying with health standards. The company expressed regret and helplessness over repeated references by some legislators and media to its products as "toxic oil," urging the public to stop spreading misinformation and help correct market information.

Regarding future legal action and compensation, Taiwan Sugar explained that it has begun internal loss assessments. A preliminary conservative estimate puts the direct economic loss from the salad oil’s delisting and sales suspension at at least NT$243 million, while intangible losses such as goodwill are still being precisely calculated. Taiwan Sugar will promptly consult with lawyers and accountants, and after finalizing the overall loss settlement, it will formally file a lawsuit against Fu Mao to seek lawful compensation.

items.title: 22檔海外ETF股價同創新高 00757近一周狂飆12%最猛
items.title_en: 22 Overseas ETFs Hit New Highs, 00757 Surges 12% in a Week
paras: 美股昨日全面大漲，市場一面消化美伊談判進展，一面迎接密集企業財報。大型科技與半導體股成為今 (5) 日市場反彈的主要推力，更帶動在台掛牌的 22 檔海外股票 ETF 股價創新高。進一步統計這 22 檔 ETF 自 7/30 低點以來漲幅，統一 FANG+ ETF(00757-TW) 以雙位數的反彈幅度居冠。

根據 CMoney 統計，股市從 7/30 自低點強彈至今，已有 22 檔海外股票 ETF 領先大盤創高，其中，統一 FANG+ ETF(00757-TW) 以 12.35% 居榜單之冠，今 (5) 日股價收 141.95 元，再次改寫歷史新高。其餘則依序為國泰網路資安 (00875-TW)、大華美國 MAG7+(009815-TW)、華南永昌 NASDAQxT(009818-TW) 及復華 S&P500 成長 (00924-TW)。
​統一 FANG+ ETF 經理人林良一表示 7 月美股劇烈分化，主因在於科技巨頭財報遇賣壓、聯準會鷹派異議首現、油價反覆。月底微軟、亞馬遜雲端財報強勁，那指終結連六黑，蘋果財測疲弱走跌，AI 變現者與硬體落後者分歧擴大。
展望後市，林良一表示，資本支出逐步轉化為雲端營收，構成續強底氣；惟鷹派異議、殖利率高檔、油價震盪仍是變數。反彈品質取決財報能否延續 AI 變現力，領軍族群已收斂至 AI 基建巨頭。短線回檔可伺機布局，長線定期定額累積。

paras_en: US stocks surged yesterday, with the market digesting progress in US-Iran talks and receiving a slew of corporate earnings reports. Large-cap tech and semiconductor stocks drove the market's rebound today, also pushing the 22 overseas-listed stock ETFs to new highs. Further analysis shows that these 22 ETFs have risen by double-digit percentages since their low point on July 30.

According to CMoney statistics, the stock market has rebounded strongly from its low point on July 30, with 22 overseas stock ETFs leading the pack in reaching new highs. Among them, the Uni-FANG+ ETF (00757-TW) topped the list with a 12.35% rebound, closing at NT$141.95 yesterday and setting a new historical high.
The other ETFs in the list, in order, are Cathay Network Security (00875-TW), Dahua America MAG7+ (009815-TW), Southern China Everbright NASDAQxT (009818-TW), and Fuhwa S&P 500 Growth (00924-TW).

Uni-FANG+ ETF manager Lin Liang-yi attributed the recent market volatility to the July US stock market's sharp differentiation, citing the sell-off in tech giants' earnings reports, the emergence of hawkish dissent among Fed officials, and the fluctuations in oil prices.

However, Lin noted that the capital expenditure is gradually being converted into cloud revenue, forming a strong foundation for the market. Nevertheless, the hawkish dissent, high interest rates, and oil price volatility remain variables that could impact the market's rebound.

The quality of the rebound will depend on whether the earnings reports can sustain the momentum of AI-driven growth, with the leading group narrowing down to AI infrastructure giants. Short-term pullbacks can be used as opportunities to position, while long-term investors can accumulate through regular, systematic investments.
